title: Director, Loss Mitigation
description:
Guild Mortgage Company , closing loans and opening doors since 1960. As a mortgage banking firm we are dedicated to serving the home owner/buyer. Our goal is to provide affordable home financing for our customers, utilizing the best terms available while providing a level of professionalism and service unsurpassed in the lending industry.
Position Summary
The Loss Mitigation Director plays an important role in the organization by overseeing several activities related to the company’s Loss Mitigation functions. Manages and develops direct reports through setting objectives, coaching, feedback, and reviews. Oversees productivity of direct reports and monitors reports to ensure department efficiency and regulatory compliance for Loss Mitigation. Assigns work/projects related to area(s) of expertise and supervision. Ensures business processes are conducted in a timely, accurate and compliant manner in full accordance with established investor, company, state and federal guidelines and regulations.
This is a remote position. Candidates living in San Diego County must be able to work a hybrid schedule during the first three months of employment before transitioning to a fully remote work arrangement to support onboarding, training, and team integration.
Compensation
This role is an exempt position with a Targeted Salary Range of $94,000 to $135,000 annually.
Compensation at Guild is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to local and federal minimum wage requirements, education, level of experience, and applicant’s geographical location.
Essential Functions

• Monitors operational performance/metrics to maximize productivity, efficiency, service, and compliance levels.

• Monitors the development of training to ensure changes and improvements relating to investor rules and regulations, compliance criteria, internal policy and guidelines, and best practices are followed.

• Monitors departmental projects to ensure they are properly prioritized, developed, tracked, and implemented.

• Works with Senior Servicing Analyst to ensure systems and processes are updated and tested. Works with Leadership Team to ensure policies and procedures reflect these changes.

• Ensures policies and procedures reflect everyday workings of applicable departments.

Qualifications

• High school diploma and some college, Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or a related field preferred.

title: Senior ServiceNow Technical Consultant
description:
Senior ServiceNow Technical Consultant
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior ServiceNow Technical Consultant with deep platform expertise and a proven history of delivering complex, enterprise‑scale ServiceNow implementations. This role requires hands‑on technical leadership across ITSM, ITOM, Discovery, and Asset Management domains, with strong consulting skills to guide architecture decisions, integrations, and platform optimization.
The ideal candidate has 5+ years of ServiceNow platform experience , has led or contributed significantly to multiple end‑to‑end deployments , and holds core ServiceNow certifications. You will work closely with stakeholders, architects, and development teams to design scalable solutions that align with organizational strategy, platform standards, and ServiceNow best practices.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Architecture & Technical Leadership

• Act as a senior technical authority for ServiceNow platform design, configuration, and customization.

• Define and enforce platform architecture standards, development patterns, and governance models.

• Lead technical design sessions and translate business requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions.

• Perform solution reviews to ensure alignment with ServiceNow best practices, performance standards, and upgrade readiness.

Implementation & Delivery

• Lead or contribute to multiple full‑lifecycle ServiceNow deployments , including requirements, design, build, test, and production rollout.

• Deliver advanced implementations across:

• IT Service Management (ITSM)

•
IT Operations Management (ITOM) - Event Management, Discovery, Service Mapping

• Hardware Asset Management (HAM)

• Software Asset Management (SAM / SAM Pro)

• Design and implement complex workflows, Flow Designer solutions, business rules, UI policies, scripted APIs, and custom applications.

• Oversee Discovery architecture, MID Server strategy, credential management, and CMDB population.

CMDB & Data Integrity

• Design and optimize CMDB data models following CSDM best practices.

• Ensure data quality, reconciliation, and normalization across Discovery, integrations, and asset data sources.

• Partner with asset and operations teams to align CMDB, HAM, SAM, and ITOM use cases.

Integrations & Automation

• Design and implement inbound and outbound integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, and custom APIs.

• Leverage Flow Designer, IntegrationHub spokes, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.

• Collaborate with enterprise architecture and security teams on integration patterns and authentication standards.

Performance, Security & Upgrades

• Optimize platform performance, including script efficiency, database usage, and asynchronous processing.

• Ensure role‑based access controls, data security, and compliance with organizational policies.

• Lead upgrade readiness activities, including impact analysis, remediation, and regression testing.

ServiceNow AI Features & Platform Intelligence (preferred)

• Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow AI and ML‑driven capabilities , including:

• Predictive Intelligence (classification, similarity, clustering)

• Agent Assist and contextual recommendations

• Automated routing and assignment optimization

Mentorship & Collaboration

• Mentor junior developers and consultants on ServiceNow development best practices.

• Conduct code reviews and technical knowledge sharing sessions.

• Collaborate with product owners, process owners, and stakeholders to continuously improve platform value.

Required Qualifications
Experience

• 5+ years of hands‑on ServiceNow platform experience

• Demonstrated experience delivering multiple enterprise‑scale ServiceNow implementations

• Strong expertise in:

• ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge)

• ITOM (Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping)

• ITAM (Hardware Asset Management, Software Asset Management)

• CMDB and CSDM align

title: Research Intern, Frontier Agents (Summer 2027)
description:
About the Role

The Agents team investigates how to build, align, and scale frontier AI systems that can tackle complex, multi-step tasks and workflows across text and speech, with a particular focus on agentic and scientific domains. Our work sits at the intersection of agent capabilities, human-computer interaction, and infrastructure-from designing post-training methods for agentic behavior to developing evaluation frameworks for open-ended tasks where traditional metrics fall short. 

As a research intern, you will work on problems at the frontier of agentic AI, where challenges in alignment, reliability, and scalability are deeply intertwined. Projects may involve developing new training recipes for self-learning and long-horizon reasoning, curating datasets for non-deterministic scientific and agentic tasks, studying failure modes in agentic behavior, or building infrastructure that enables agent operations at scale. You'll operate in a space where algorithmic innovation, dataset and interaction design, and systems work come together to push the boundaries of what AI agents can reliably accomplish.

Responsibilities

• Research and implement novel techniques in one or more of our focus areas

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses

• Document findings in scientific publications and blog posts

• Communicate the plans, progress, and results of projects to the broader team

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Science, or a related field

• Publications at leading ML, NLP, or speech conferences or journals (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, *ACL, EMNLP, Interspeech)

• Strong knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals

• Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.)

• Understanding of how LLMs work

• Strong programming skills in Python

• Familiarity with Transformer architectures and recent developments in foundation models

Example Research Directions

• Training, developing, and evaluating frontier models, especially in the domain of agentic tasks and workflows

• Designing and curating datasets for frontier agents alignment and post-training

• Studying failure modes and developing safety paradigms for agentic behavior

• Research new recipes (for RL or test time scaling) for self-learning and long-context tasks completion

• Building agents that act on spoken input to carry out complex, multi-step tasks

• Developing ML infrastructure that can power agent operations at scale

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span either May 17th to August 6th or June 14th to September 3rd. 

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $58 - $70 an hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

title: Client & Product Success Manager
description:
You’re the calm in the chaos for clients-and the voice of the user for the product. This role blends client account management with product success, supporting both advertising clients and users of an AI-driven ad analysis tool. If you love working with clients and shaping how products deliver value, this one’s for you.
About the Company: A leading provider of Amazon growth services. They help brands optimize advertising, improve product visibility, and develop e-commerce strategies that drive measurable results. As the company grows, we’re looking for someone who can work directly with the owner, and serve as a trusted partner in supporting high-impact projects that accelerate client success.
Location: Eastern Europe/Europe - Fully Remote
Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of advertising clients and AI tool users

• Own client communication end-to-end: emails, calls, follow-ups, and proactive check-ins

• Translate advertising performance and product insights into clear, actionable recommendations

• Run biweekly or monthly client calls, aligning on goals, performance, and next steps

• Support onboarding and ongoing adoption of the AI ad analysis platform

• Gather client and user feedback and turn it into clear insights for internal teams

• Collaborate closely with PPC managers, product, and leadership to ensure client objectives are met

• Hold internal stakeholders accountable for deliverables and timelines

• Track account health, satisfaction, and risk signals across both service and product clients

• Keep CRM, documentation, and internal tools accurate and up to date

Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful

• Client Account Management Experience: Proven background managing client relationships in an agency or service-based environment

• Product / SaaS Mindset: Experience in Customer Success, Product Success, or supporting SaaS users is a big plus

• Communication Mastery: Clear, confident, and professional-both written and verbal

• Analytical Thinking: Comfortable explaining performance data and product insights in plain language

• Organization & Ownership: You manage priorities, follow through, and keep things moving

• Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with tools like CRMs, Google Workspace, Slack, task management tools, and dashboards

• Amazon Ads Familiarity: Basic Amazon PPC knowledge or strong motivation to learn quickly

• Proactive & Curious: You spot issues early and look for ways to improve client and user experience

Your Perks: What's in it for you

• Remote-First Role: Work from anywhere

• Location Preference: Eastern Europe is a strong plus, but not a hard requirement

• Career Growth: Exposure to both client services and product success paths

• Cross-Functional Impact: Work closely with product, PPC, and leadership teams

• Learning & Development: Deepen your expertise in Amazon advertising and SaaS products

• Flexible Schedule: Time-zone friendly collaboration with a results-first mindset

Why Adaptive Teams ?
At Adaptive Teams , we don’t just fill positions - we create pathways to success. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we’re here to help you grow, innovate, and make an impact. If you’re looking for exciting opportunities and, a team that’s as passionate as you are, this is the place to be.
What to Expect from Our Application Process?
Once you apply, you’ll receive an email guiding you through the next steps, including an assessment tailored to the role. Be sure to check your inbox (and your spam folder , just in case) for further instructions.

We understand your time is valuable , so we strive to keep the assessment process under 45 minutes whenever possible, though some roles may require a slightly longer time investment.

Once selected, you’ll have the chance to schedule your first interview with our team. We aim to make the process as smooth and transparent as possible, so you’ll always know where you stand.

description:
Position Summary
Fòs Feminista is inviting applications for new members of its Board of Directors and standing committees. For the 2026 elections, we seek candidates whose experience and perspectives will complement the current Board and committees, in particular with financial and investment expertise and audit, risk, and governance experience. We encourage applications from feminist leaders under 25 at the time of election who have a record of leadership in youth-led movements, digital participation, or community organizing, especially in the Global South.
Opportunities in 2026
Board Directors
Fòs Feminista is governed by an 11-member Board of Directors. Board Directors guide strategy and share responsibility for the Alliance's governance and financial health. Board Directors attend three meetings each year, and each Director serves on at least one standing committee. All Board Directors carry the legal duties of care, loyalty, and obedience to mission; disclose potential conflicts of interest annually; and uphold Fòs Feminista ’s safeguarding policy.
The term is for three years, renewable for up to two additional consecutive terms. Board service is unpaid. Fòs Feminista arranges, covers, or reimburses eligible travel expenses for organizational and governance work.
Standing Committee Members
The Board's work is supported by six standing committees: Advocacy; Audit and Risk Intelligence; Finance and Investment; Governance; Partnerships and Performance; and Resource Mobilization.
What We Are Seeking in 2026
To complement the experience already represented on the Board and its committees, we are prioritizing candidates with one or more of the following:

• Youth leadership. Rights-based leaders under 25 at the time of election, with substantive experience in youth-led movements, digital advocacy, and community or health organizing, particularly in the Global South.

• Finance and investment. Experience in financial leadership, gender-lens investing, innovative financing, or women's economic empowerment.

• Strategic communications and external relations.

• Movement and civil society leadership. Deep roots in civil society networks, feminist organizations, or social movements, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean and across the Global South.

• Governance. Board or senior leadership experience, particularly in Global South organizations.

What All Candidates Should Bring

• Commitment to SRHRJ, and the ability to communicate about this work.

• Understanding of the changing political, economic, and global public health landscape.

• A horizontal approach to leadership, including a willingness to share and build collective power, interrogate established practices, and enable innovation.

• Integrity, equanimity, active listening, confidence in taking risks, and the ability to build consensus across differences.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work across cultures and institutional contexts.

• The ability to connect Fòs Feminista with new partners, funders, and other social justice movements.

title: Software Engineer, Location & Motion (Inertial Navigation / GNSS)
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

We’re looking for an experienced engineer to own the navigation and positioning stack for Rivet’s head-worn and body-worn systems. You will be responsible for turning inertial and GNSS sensor data into a robust, continuous estimate of position and orientation across challenging real-world environments. This includes sensor calibration and characterization, inertial navigation, GNSS integration, and the estimation algorithms that bring these inputs together. You will work closely with our perception team to define how navigation and visual tracking complement one another and provide a stable experience to downstream systems. This is a highly hands-on role spanning algorithms, embedded software, hardware integration, laboratory testing, and field validation.

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end 9-axis inertial sensing system, including accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer calibration, synchronization, coordinate frames, and attitude estimation.

- Develop robust heading and inertial navigation solutions that account for sensor errors, environmental disturbances, temperature variation, and platform effects.

- Own GNSS integration and performance, including receiver configuration, raw measurement analysis, signal quality characterization, and resilience to degraded or unreliable positioning environments.

- Design and maintain the navigation fusion estimator, combining inertial, GNSS, and other available measurements into a continuous position, velocity, and attitude solution with well-characterized uncertainty.

- Develop calibration and characterization methods for production and field use, including sensor characterization, per-unit calibration, and automated validation.

- Partner with hardware, firmware, mechanical, and manufacturing teams on sensor selection, placement, mechanical integration, power and thermal constraints, and production test requirements.

- Define interfaces between the navigation and perception systems, including transitions between absolute navigation and relative visual tracking.

- Build the testing and validation infrastructure needed to measure navigation performance, replay real-world data, diagnose failures, and prevent regressions across releases.

Requirements

- BS + 8 years, MS + 5 years, or PhD + 3 years of experience in navigation, aerospace/GNC, robotics, geomatics, or a closely related field.

- Demonstrated experience owning and shipping a production navigation solution that provides position and attitude estimates.

- Strong hands-on experience with inertial sensing, magnetometer calibration, heading estimation, GNSS, and sensor fusion.

- Deep understanding of strapdow

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Step 3 - Let's Actually Talk
A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.
Step 4 - The Fine Print, Made Fun
We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor-hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.
Step 5 - Matchmaking Time
Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.
Step 6 - Showtime
Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way-with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.
Step 7 - The Verdict
We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Die BlueBranch GmbH in Fürth baut eigene Apps. Kein Agentur-Ping-Pong, keine Website-Pflege: Wir entwickeln Produkte, die im App Store und bei Google Play stehen und jeden Tag von echten Menschen genutzt werden. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, arbeiten täglich mit KI-Tools und bringen eine Idee in Tagen in den Store, nicht in Monaten. Wir suchen kein Design-Rädchen, sondern jemanden, der unsere Apps in Look, Feel und Marke auf das Niveau der besten Apps im Store hebt. Weil das nur mit echtem Ownership funktioniert, bieten wir dir eine Gewinnbeteiligung am Unternehmen.
Aufgaben
- Du designst unsere Apps von der ersten Skizze bis zum fertigen Screen für iOS und Android. Fokus 100 % App, keine Websites.
- Du setzt den Standard: Interfaces, die sich anfühlen wie die besten Apps im Store. Micro-Interactions, Animationen, Haptik, Details, die man spürt.
- Du entwickelst und pflegst Corporate Identity und Corporate Design unserer App-Marken: Logo, Farben, Typografie, Bildsprache, Tonalität. Konsistent vom App-Icon bis zum Store-Listing.
- Du gestaltest Social-Media-Postings, Reels-Formate, Store-Screenshots, App-Preview-Videos und Ad-Creatives, die unsere Apps sichtbar machen.
- Du baust und pflegst unser Design-System mit Tokens, Komponenten, Typografie und Motion und sorgst dafür, dass es im Code genauso ankommt, wie es gemeint war.
- Du designst mit KI: Mit Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, v0 oder Midjourney erkundest du Varianten, erstellst Prototypen und Assets. Dann verfeinerst du die beste Richtung mit deinem eigenen Urteil.
- Du verantwortest UX-Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Daten: Onboarding, Paywalls und Conversion-Strecken gestaltest du und misst ihren Erfolg mit Funnel-Analysen, A/B-Tests und Nutzerfeedback.
- Du bringst Designs zum Leben mit Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Lottie oder Rive.
- Du achtest auf Barrierefreiheit, Tablet-Layouts, Apple HIG und Material Design.

title: Initiativbewerbung
description:
über uns
Hey! Wir sind nucao, das Leipziger Food-Startup, das beweist, dass Genuss und Gutes tun Hand in Hand gehen. Unsere Mission: Wir krempeln die Schokoladenindustrie um. Mit Snacks, die nicht nur unglaublich lecker, sondern auch bio, vegan, fair gehandelt und revolutionär verpackt sind.

We change the game, for good - BAM!
deine rolle

Du willst immer auf dem neuesten Stand bleiben, was unsere aktuellen Vakanzen angeht? Dann melde dich gerne hier zu unserem Job-Newsletter an!
Du feierst unsere Mission, aber die passende Rolle fehlt?
Cool, dass du proaktiv bist! Wir lieben diesen Drive. Bevor du aber deine Unterlagen hochlädst, hier ein ehrlicher Einblick von uns:
1. Wir besetzen sehr gezielt. Wir sind ein Startup. Das heißt: Wir schaffen neue Stellen meist erst dann, wenn der Bedarf akut ist. Wir haben selten die Kapazität, eine Stelle "um eine Person herum" zu bauen. Die Chance, dass eine Initiativbewerbung zu einem Job führt, ist daher meistens unrealisitisch, selbst wenn dein Profil großartig ist.
2. Schau erst auf unsere Job-Liste. Bitte prüfe unbedingt zuerst unsere offenen Stellen. Passt da wirklich nichts? Auch nicht zu 80%? Eine Bewerbung auf eine konkrete Stelle landet immer schneller beim richtigen Hiring Manager.
3. Du bist trotzdem überzeugt, dass du das fehlende Puzzleteil bist? Du hast Skills, von denen wir noch gar nicht wissen, dass wir sie brauchen? Oder du hast eine konkrete Idee, wie du nucao voranbringst?Dann: Go for it!

dein skillset

Was wir von dir brauchen: Da es keine Stellenbeschreibung gibt, liegt der Ball bei dir.

• Lade deinen CV hoch.

• Wichtig: Verrate uns im Motivationsschreiben (oder Video) nicht nur, wer du bist, sondern welches konkrete Problem du bei uns lösen möchtest . In welchem Bereich siehst du deinen Impact?

Wir sind gespannt auf deinen Pitch!

was wir bieten

Wir fordern viel, aber wir geben verdammt viel zurück.

• Deine Lernkurve? Senkrecht! Wir glauben an dein Potenzial und geben dir früh Verantwortung. Du bist ein vollwertiges Teammitglied und lernst in einem rasant wachsenden Startup.

• Echter Impact, der schmeckt: Bei uns ist Sinnhaftigkeit kein Buzzword. Du forderst aktiv die großen Player heraus, indem du die internen Strukturen und Prozesse schaffst, die wir für unser schnelles Wachstum und den Erfolg unserer Mission brauchen.

• Fokus auf deine Stärken: Wir fördern dich aktiv. Mit Tools wie dem Clifton StrengthsFinder entdecken wir, was dich antreibt, und bauen deine Talente aus.

• Teamzusammenhalt: Auf dich wartet ein hochmotiviertes Team, das dich intensiv einarbeitet und mithilft. Und natürlich legendäre Teamevents - von Baumpflanzaktionen bis zu wilden Partys.

• Echte Benefits: Kostenloses veganes Mittagessen im Office, Remote-Zuschuss, Supplements für deine Gesundheit, Urban Sports Club, soviel nucao wie du essen kannst und eine moderne betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit ETF-Sparplänen.

title: Vice President - Sales & Business Development
description:
About Zeta:

Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities.

Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors.

About the Role:

Zeta is looking for a highly entrepreneurial VP of Sales & Business Development to help build the book of business across sponsor banks, BIN sponsors, agent banks, program managers, and fintechs. This is a 0-1 role that will be responsible for creating, qualifying, progressing, and closing high-quality opportunities across debit, prepaid, credit, lending, and adjacent banking technology propositions.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on business builder with strong existing relationships in the US banking, sponsor bank, and fintech ecosystem; the ability to open senior doors; and the commercial discipline to convert market access into qualified pipeline, active pursuits, and signed revenue.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Own prospect identification, segmentation, prioritization, and outreach across named accounts based on segment attractiveness, buying intent, relationship access, fit with Zeta’s capabilities, and likelihood of conversion

• Open doors and establish trusted access to decision makers, sponsors, and influencers across banks, regulated financial institutions, program managers, fintechs, processors, networks, consultants, and other ecosystem participants

• Build & nurture qualified pipeline that meets clear standards including named prospect, named buyer or sponsor, documented use case, estimated annual contract value, and next meeting or decision milestone scheduled

• Drive the full deal journey for assigned opportunities spanning discovery, qualification, solution framing, pitching, pricing inputs, business case development, stakeholder mapping, procurement support, contracting support, and deal closure

• Anchor pre-sales engagements in partnership with the sales engineering team to create & deliver demos, POCs, tabletop-exercises, solution workshops, discovery sessions, and other impactful formats that generate traction with clients

- You'd rather manage a team than close deals yourself for the first year.

- You don't thrive at the fast pace of early-stage startups.

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

- Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Our Site Reliability Engineering team owns the reliability, observability and incident management of the internal engineering platform that product teams across Everpure build and run their services on. We define how reliability is measured, operate the shared services the platform depends on, run the incident lifecycle, and remove the operational toil that slows engineering down.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer in Prague you will own the reliability of a group of platform services end to end and lead one or more of the programmes that raise reliability across the organisation. You will set technical direction within your area, guide less experienced engineers, and work closely with the product teams whose services run on the platform and with SRE colleagues in our other engineering sites.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Service level objectives and error budgets. Lead the definition of objectives with service owners, design how they are measured and reported, and own the reliability indicators the organisation tracks, including time to detect and time to recover. Use them to shape the team's priorities and to make the case for reliability work with engineering leadership.

• Observability. Set the direction for a consistent pipeline for metrics, logs and alerts across our data centres and public cloud. Drive improvements in detection speed and alert quality across teams, and define the standards that service owners build to.

• Incident management. Take part in the on-call rotation and act as incident commander for significant incidents. Lead blameless postmortems, make sure their actions are completed, and improve the incident process itself: ownership, escalation, communication and review.

• Shared platform services. Own the architecture and operation of the messaging, caching, database and continuous-integration services the platform depends on. Lead their evolution to highly available designs, including redundancy, capacity planning, upgrade strategy and tested recovery procedures.

• Automation. Identify the largest sources of operational toil and lead the engineering work that removes them. Help define how AI is applied to incident triage and remediation, including the safeguards around automated actions, and measure the effect on recovery time.

• Production readiness. Run design and production-readiness reviews for new and changing services, set the reliability expectations product teams are held to, and coach engineers across teams on reliability practices.

• Technical leadership. Mentor engineers on the team, review designs and changes, and represent the team's reliability work with partner teams and leadership.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Prague office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

• Strong software engineering proficiency in languages such as Python or Go, with experience building operational tooling for platform scale.

• Hands-on expertise operating distributed systems on Linux and Kubernetes using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines across multi-cloud or hybrid environments.

title: Senior Product Designer - Growth
description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms-so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive-designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Render’s mission is simple: eliminate the tedious work of building software by providing a cloud platform that just works.

We’re evolving from the go-to platform for solo developers into the backbone for fast-scaling teams. This role sits at the heart of that shift: how a developer discovers Render, achieves their first success, and becomes a paying customer whose bill makes sense to them. That journey spans onboarding and activation, billing, payments, and pricing - the moments where trust is won or lost and where good design directly moves the business. Because the journey crosses the whole product, you won’t be siloed on a single team; you’ll work across the groups that own these surfaces - product, billing, and more - following the work wherever it leads.

This is a craft-focused IC role built for speed, scale, and variety. You won’t polish one screen for a month; you’ll ship a lot, learn fast, and raise the bar across a wide surface. The craft bar is high - this is still Render, where details matter - but here it’s expressed through velocity: designs that ship, get measured, and compound. You’ll move between a pricing page, an upgrade flow, an onboarding step, and a billing surface in the same week, and hold all of them to the same standard.

What makes this work hard and interesting: these surfaces are deceptively high-stakes. A confusing bill erodes trust as fast as a failed deploy. A pricing page that misleads costs real money and goodwill. Payments and billing are where correctness, clarity, and edge-case rigor matter as much as polish - and where “the unglamorous flow” is the product.

title: Proposal Tools Analyst
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Proposal Tools Analyst

Purpose

The Apollo programme is replacing the many separate tools used at each sales stage with one operating model. In the Proposing stage, that means one new proposal platform that produces a single, standard customer business case. It replaces the self-service tools that today give different answers for the same customer scenario.

The Proposal Tools Analyst lays the groundwork that makes this possible. You will work through the existing business case, TCO, RFX and proposal tools. You'll turn what you learn into one prioritised, traceable set of requirements. Then you'll make sure each old tool is retired safely.

The role has three parts:

• Understand the estate. Work with each tool owner to document what their tool does, what data it relies on, who uses it and why.

• Define the platform. Turn that understanding into one set of system requirements that the build team works and tests against.

• Retire safely. Switch off each old tool only once the new platform has been shown to cover what the field needs from it.

What Success Looks Like

• Every proposal, business case and RFP tool in GSO is known to the programme. Each in-scope tool has a full document that its owner has checked.

• There is one requirements catalogue, kept in sync with the prototype. Every requirement traces back to the field need and the tool it came from.

title: Last Mile Lead (Admin)

Hledáme parťáka nebo parťačku, kdo si vezme pod křídla administrativu a koordinaci kurýrní služby. Budeš pravou rukou Vedoucího logistiky, křižovatkou komunikace mezi externími dodavateli, skladem i dalšími odděleními a člověkem, díky kterému budou všechny provozní procesy a pravidla fungovat bez drhnutí.

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Přímý dopad na zákaznickou zkušenost: Tvá agenda v oblasti kvality, doručování a řešení incidentů přímo ovlivňuje spokojenost našich zákazníků.

- Rozmanitá agenda: Propojíš každodenní administrativu, práci s daty a systémy s intenzivní komunikací s lidmi v terénu.

- Prostor pro rozvoj a inovace: Dostaneš příležitost navrhovat zlepšení procesů, zavádět nové projekty do praxe a profesně se posouvat v prostředí e-commerce lídra.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Péče o kvalitu a komunikace s dodavateli: Každodenní kontakt s dodavateli kurýrních služeb, vyhodnocování kvality (styl jízdy, včasnost, poškození zboží), poskytování zpětné vazby a hlídání fluktuace.

- Nábor, školení a zapracování: Zodpovědnost za nábor a zaškolení nových kurýrů, nastavení cílů pro nováčky a komunikace s jejich buddy.

- Denní operativa a administrativa: Vedení denní agendy (stravenky, nevrácené nákupy, záměny tašek, ověřování věku, stížnosti a pochvaly).

- Práce s daty a systémy: Správa a doplňování provozních reportů, práce v interních systémech Rohlíku.

- Optimalizace procesů: Spolupráce se skladem, kvalitou a bezpečností na zefektivnění komunikace a zavádění nových postupů.

- Plnění klíčových KPIs: Sledování a zkracování délky nakládky, eliminace zpoždění na nakládce i u zákazníka.

CO OD TEBE OČEKÁVÁME

- Drive a energie: Chuť pracovat v rychlém provozním prostředí a schopnost přenášet pozitivní energii na ostatní.
